rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges limits of a single image, but it overstates confidence in AA features; TE cohesion and fully expanded status are not crisply demonstrable from this frame alone.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, oocyte yield, BMI, endometriosis, prior IVF outcome, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overconfidence from image-based morphology limits a perfect score.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including single embryo transfer and avoiding unsupported add-ons; minor issue is leaning heavily on morphology despite image limitations.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, and reassessment if failure occurs, though future-cycle planning could be more specific diagnostically.
